method: 120 unique public recordings, 40 speakers, clean/quiet/noise variants. Two warm passes, accuracy from pass 1. Same Mac; sequential engine runs. Local desktop activity and model downloads were not disabled. No deliberate CPU contention. No app installation or microphone recording.
first_load_caveat: Fresh process with existing system Core ML caches; candidate artifacts first used here. Not a cache-cleared first-install measurement.
latency: Swift engine call on preloaded raw PCM; EOU complete-buffer processing plus flush; production separately includes preparation/gating and formatting/IPC.
